-- ofertas por estado
SELECT status, count(*) FROM offers WHERE request_id = '9cc4b535-a283-4ea3-8cf4-14f4192ef301' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

CANCELADA|49

-- eventos TripAssigned
SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE type = 'TripAssigned' AND payload->>'solicitudId' = '9cc4b535-a283-4ea3-8cf4-14f4192ef301'

-- la solicitud después de cancelar
SELECT status FROM ride_requests WHERE id = '9cc4b535-a283-4ea3-8cf4-14f4192ef301'
